C: A celestial humanoid species with a slender build and a face of divine maturity. The hair is long and flowing, colored a shimmering platinum white and topped with a golden tiara. The eyes are sharp and focused, colored a deep sapphire blue. The outfit is a white bodysuit with gold armor plates, white gloves, and a long white veil. The design features two large, feathered white wings on the back. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
